formulas.expression: IF(AND(NOT(ISNULL({!Get_BotForm_Record.Customer_ID__c})), {!Get_BotForm_Record.Customer_ID__c} <> ''), BR() + 'Customer ID: ' + {!Get_BotForm_Record.Customer_ID__c} + '.', '') + IF(AND(NOT(ISNULL({!Get_BotForm_Record.Division_ID__c})), {!Get_BotForm_Record.Division_ID__c} <> ''), BR() + 'Division ID: ' + {!Get_BotForm_Record.Division_ID__c} + '.', '') + IF(AND(NOT(ISNULL({!Get_BotForm_Record.Department_ID__c})), {!Get_BotForm_Record.Department_ID__c} <> ''), BR() + 'Department ID: ' + {!Get_BotForm_Record.Department_ID__c} + '.', '') + IF(AND(NOT(ISNULL({!Get_BotForm_Record.Anything_else_you_d_like_us_to_know__c})), {!Get_BotForm_Record.Anything_else_you_d_like_us_to_know__c} <> ''), BR() + 'Case Description: ' + {!Get_BotForm_Record.Anything_else_you_d_like_us_to_know__c} + '.', '') + IF(AND(NOT(ISNULL({!Get_Messaging_Session.Email__c})), {!Get_Messaging_Session.Email__c} <> ''), BR() + 'Email: ' + {!Get_Messaging_Session.Email__c} + '.', '')
